systems.country_label: plate-forme e-Foncier Bénin; base de données cadastrales; cadastre national
systems.owner: the national cadastre, under the project Ppmec with Netherlands finance; data collected and updated by contractors
systems.tiers: the three arrondissements of the commune of Parakou, supported since 2022, with 142,480 parcels registered and 1,061 updates entered by 1 April 2026; the mairie's land service is asked to equip itself to keep the parcels up to date, which the document names as a challenge still to meet

note: The Netherlands ambassador's visit of 1 April 2026 to the cadastre work in Parakou; the communes' taking over of the updating system is named as a challenge, and nothing is stated about the mairie's data connection.
